summary: The agent develops a structurally sound LightGBM solution with good domain-specific feature engineering (e.g. distance metrics, landmarks) and data cleaning. However, it ignores the temporal nature of the dataset by using a random shuffle split, and it entirely fails to print or log any internal validation metrics to estimate model generalisation.
